description: This file defines the AsyncSocket class template implementing asynchronous socket memory management and I/O strategies, including corking, uncorking, writing, and socket control functions within the uWS namespace.

classes.name: AsyncSocket
classes.description: Template class implementing asynchronous socket memory management, corking, writing, and control functions with support for SSL.

methods.name: throttle_helper
methods.description: Controls socket throttling by pausing or resuming event polling.

methods.name: getNativeHandle
methods.description: Returns SSL pointer or file descriptor as a void pointer.

methods.name: getLoopData
methods.description: Retrieves loop-specific data associated with the socket.

methods.name: getAsyncSocketData
methods.description: Retrieves socket extension data.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Sets socket timeout in seconds.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the socket without automatic drainage.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses socket event polling (experimental).

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes socket event polling (experimental).

methods.name: close
methods.description: Immediately closes the socket.

methods.name: corkUnchecked
methods.description: Corks the socket without validation.

methods.name: uncorkWithoutSending
methods.description: Uncorks the socket without sending data.

methods.name: cork
methods.description: Corks the socket, ensuring only one socket is corked per loop.

methods.name: isCorked
methods.description: Checks if the socket is corked.

methods.name: canCork
methods.description: Checks if the socket can be corked.

methods.name: getSendBuffer
methods.description: Provides a buffer for temporary data assembly, with corking logic.

methods.name: getBufferedAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of buffered data in user space.

methods.name: addressAsText
methods.description: Converts binary IP address to text form.

methods.name: getRemoteAddress
methods.description: Retrieves remote IP address.

methods.name: getRemoteAddressAsText
methods.description: Returns remote IP address as text.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to socket with prioritization and buffering.

methods.name: uncork
methods.description: Uncorks the socket and flushes corked or passed data.
